author: Porkyyy
body:
Hello.

It is quite annoying when you die 5 seconds right after an SG game begins because someone kills you right off spawn.
A grace period of 10 or so seconds would help prevent this, and I'm sure a lot of players would like the same thing.

Please discuss.

I understand your problem here but im going to be the guy to say.

Tough luck

It's a part of the game, its a major part of the game mode, you rush or you don't, that's a decision your supposed to make, are you going to risk going to the center? Or will you play it safe? Its not supposed to be easy to rush in and get the chests safely.  A grace period takes away that crucial decision, not everybody is supposed to rush and make it out alive, that's not how it is, there are supposed to be early deaths, I understand it doesn't have to be 100% according to the book but its called survival games for a reason, to be like the hunger games.  And this is a crucial part of the hunger games, the initial bloodbath at center.

If you want a chance to get ready before combat, I would suggest the walls instead of survival games

replies.author: voidloop
Murphh
replies.body:
Originally, I supported the grace period, but after reading these posts, I changed my mind.

I usually avoid the middle at the start because...
1) players like to target me
2) I'm a slow sprinter (chests are empty when I arrive)
3) my pvp skills aren't top notch (punching vs sword)

A grace period at this point would just benefit my competition by allowing faster players to gear up uncontested.  It's better for me if players slug it out in the mid and eliminate each other early.

I usually find suitable gear when I bypass mid anyways.  My biggest challenges now are just getting familiar with the new maps,creating a route for looting chests, creating alliances, and surviving for death match.

No=grace period
